suite: Equivalent under conditions: VeriEQL LeetCode (every 8th case)
score: 413 cases proved only under conditions beyond the declared ones, 0 wrong
metric: Of 3,000 cases (every eighth of 23,994), the 1,804 the prover does not prove outright with the spec's own types, keys, NOT NULL columns and foreign keys (1,196 are proved outright): 413 proved under a minimal set of extra NOT NULL, unique-key and foreign-key conditions, 1,391 unknown (1,380 with no proof, and 11 conditional proofs the executed check cannot re-check (not scored: 7 rest on a composite foreign key it cannot impose, 4 hold only when a column is NOT NULL and make both queries constant on every test database)).
correctness: 0 wrong, 0 crashed: every conditional proof passed the executed counterexample search with its conditions added to the spec (300 databases, then 300 wider ones) with no difference; the prover loses each proof when any one condition is dropped; 141 are separated by a database that breaks the conditions
caveats: A sample, not the whole set (3,000 of 23,994 cases). Proof under assumed conditions beyond the declared ones. No held-out split reserved; the harness was developed against Singh dev pairs and an early 80-case sample (tuned on test). Conditions beyond the spec are rarer than on the Singh pairs because the declared keys already carry what the prover can use. Measured 2026-11-12 on commit 395b5c1 (hardest-cases batch 3, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 20), with main 0e94662 measured the same way on the same sample as the baseline (879 outright, 335 conditional, 1,781 unknown, 5 not re-checkable): no pair moved the other way; 50 unknown pairs became outright proofs, 39 unknown pairs conditional, and two pairs that a database separated before (they differ only on a row whose column is NULL) now read as conditional on that column being NOT NULL and are not re-checkable. On the first measurement (2026-10-04) the count was 297. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on 9dadccb, the fourth and fifth hardest-cases batches (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 38) on main 2cf0154: 1,196 outright, 413 conditional, 1,380 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. Main's prover (711a01b) measured the same way on the same sample: 1,189 outright, 379 conditional, 1,422 unknown, 10 not re-checkable; the distance from the 374 recorded on 2026-11-12 comes from rule batches merged in between and was not traced here. Compared case by case with that run: 36 unknown cases became conditional, 5 unknown cases and 2 conditional ones became outright proofs, 1 unknown case became a conditional proof that is not re-checkable (not scored), 4 conditional proofs name a different minimal set, and no proof is lost. 23 of the 36 read the sales table, 4 the insurance table, and the rest salesperson, orders, views and employee tables. The 413 use 593 conditions (456 NOT NULL, 120 unique, 17 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (289, 87, 25, 7, 3, 2 proofs). The batches' rules were written on development pairs of the Singh conditional eval, which holds some of the same LeetCode problems; this sample was run for scoring and its cases were not read. Measured before main's date fix for counterexamples (b8df3d5) was merged into the branch; that change's own validation ran this sample on main (1,189 outright, 379 conditional, 0 wrong), and the sample was not rerun on the merged tree.
